color-by-number.intro: Igridi yesikwere yezikwere ezikhulu, enye nenye inenamba, kunye nesitshixo phezulu kwayo esinemibala emine, enye nenye inenamba yayo kunye negama layo ebhaliweyo. Khetha umbala kwisitshixo, emva koko cofa izikwere ukuze uzizalise. Igridi yi-4 ngu-4 ukuqala, ine-6 ngu-6 kunye ne-8 ngu-8 xa ufuna izikwere ezingakumbi. Xa wonke isikwere sinombala wenamba yaso, igridi yile mifanekiso esiphepheni. Izikwere ezizaliswe ngombala omnye nje ngumfanekiso wakho, kwaye umdlalo awuthethi nto ngawo. "Zalisa ngamanani" izalisa zonke izikwere ezingenanto kuwe.
howTo: Khetha ubukhulu begridi. I-4 ngu-4 inezikwere ezikhulu kakhulu kwaye lula kakhulu.
Jonga isitshixo phezulu kwegridi. Umbala ngamnye unenamba negama, njengo-1 Yellow.
Cofa umbala kwisitshixo, emva koko cofa izikwere ofuna ukuzizalisa ngawo.
Sebenzisa umbala ofana nenamba, okanye nawuphi umbala ofuna. Zombini ziyalungile.
Cofa "Zalisa ngamanani" ukuze uzalise izikwere ezingenanto, "Cima" ukuqala igridi kwakhona, okanye "Omnye umfanekiso" ukuze ufumane elinye.
tips: Hlalani ecaleni komnye nicele iindawo: omnye umntu akhethe umbala, omnye acofe isikwere.
Thethani ngemibala: "Ndiyithanda eluhlaza." Akukho sidingo sokuchaza ukuba umfanekiso uya kuba yintoni.
Kwisikrini esincinci igridi ye-8 ngu-8 iyahamba ecaleni ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo. Izikwere zihlala zikwisayizi elungileyo.
Inguqulelo yephepha nayo isebenza kakuhle ngeepenseli kwitafile ecaleni kombhedi.

faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotsho, amanqaku, umbalisi wokuhamba okanye ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka kwisiqingatha sendlela yokugqiba kakuhle.

faq.q: Kuthekani ukuba ndisebenzisa umbala ohluke kwinamba?
faq.a: Akukho nto eyenzekayo, kwaye yiyo le nto ibaluleke. Nawuphi umbala unokufakwa kuyo nayiphi na isikwere, kwaye umdlalo awuthethi nto ngawo. Xa wonke isikwere sinombala wenamba yaso, umdlalo uyasitshilo ngobumnene, kwaye umfanekiso ngemibala yakho ulungile ngokulinganayo.

faq.q: Ingaba imibala emine inokwahlulwa ngabantu abangaboni imibala?
faq.a: Ikhethwe ukuze yenze loo nto. Umbala ngamnye unenamba, igama ebhaliweyo kunye nesimo sayo esincinci, ngoko umbala awusoloko yindlela kuphela yokuwahlula. Ukuzaliswa okune kuhlolwe ngokusebenzisa iimodeli zokungaboni kakuhle imibala ebomvu-eluhlaza kunye nebhlowu-yellow, kwaye zikwahluke ngokukhanya. Umntu ongaboni kakuhle imibala akakazami, ngoko sicela usixelele ukubaimibala emibini ifana.

faq.q: Ingaba izikwere zikhulu ngokwaneleyo kwintshukumo yesandla okanye kwisikrini esincinci?
faq.a: Isikwere ngasinye sineepikseli ezingama-48 ubukhulu ubuncinci, kwaye ezingama-56 kwigridi ye-4 ngu-4. Ukuba igridi ibanzi kakhulu kwisikrini, iyahamba ecaleni ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo endaweni yokuncitshiswa kwezikwere.
Ewe. Iphepha elinye linegridi enenamba kunye nesitshixo semibala emine ngamagama ayo. Dawula isikwere ngasinye ngepenseli yombala ofana nenamba yaso, okanye nawuphi umbala ofuna.
Ewe, iyasimahla, akukho akhawunti, akukho kubhalisa okanye ukulayisha phantsi. Isebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwitafile okanye kwikhompyuter.

pattern-maker.name: Umenzi wepatheni
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Umenzi wepatheni: Yilungise itayile kwaye ushicilele ipatheni
pattern-maker.h1: Umenzi wepatheni: Yilungise itayile, uyibone iphinda
pattern-maker.description: Tshintsha izikwere zetayile encinci kwaye ubone iphinda ibe lipatheni ecaleni kwayo, ngemibala emine enegama kunye nesimo ngasinye. Akukho xesha okanye amanqaku. Simahla ukudlala nokushicilela.
pattern-maker.short: Tshintsha izikwere zetayile encinci kwaye ubone iphinda ibe lipatheni.
pattern-maker.intro: Itayile encinci ye-3 ngu-3 izikwere, okanye ye-4 ngu-4 ukuba uyafuna, kwaye ecaleni kwayo "ipatheni yakho": itayile efanayo iphindwe ibe lilokhi. Cofa isikwere kwaye siguquke sibe ngumbala olandelayo kwemibala emine, enegama layo ebhaliweyo kunye nesimo sayo. Ipatheni ecaleni kwayo itshintsha ngoko nangoko. Akukho patheni elungileyo kwaye akukho nto egciniweyo okanye ethunyelwayo. "Shicilela ipatheni yam" ibeka ipatheni ephindiweyo kwiphepha elinye ukuze uyigcine, uyidawule okanye uyinike.
howTo: Jonga itayile kunye nepatheni yakho ecaleni kwayo. Zitayile efanayo, ephindiweyo.
Cofa isikwere. Siguquka sibe ngumbala olandelayo kumzila wemibala emine ongaphezulu.
Qhubeka ucofa izikwere de ipatheni ibonakale njengoko ufuna. Nawuphi umzekelo ulungile.
Cofa "Ndimangalise" ukuze ufumane itayile entsha, okanye "Qala kwakhona" ukuze ufumane eyicocekileyo. "Ibuyisele" ibuyisela itayile owayinayo.
Cofa "Shicilela ipatheni yam" ukuba uyayifuna ephepheni, okanye cofa Phumla ukuze uyeke.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Talk about what you see: "That looks like a flower." There is no need to name anything.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.
Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

drawing-duet.name: Drawing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Picture
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Two People, One Sheet
drawing-duet.description: Two people take turns drawing lines on one shared canvas, each in a color of their own. Nobody scores or wins, and the picture can be saved or printed. Free to play, with no account.
drawing-duet.short: Take turns drawing one shared picture with someone beside you.
drawing-duet.intro: One canvas, two people. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name. You take turns: draw one line or shape, then pass the pen. Either of you may pass at any time. There is no right picture and no score. Save the picture to your device if you like it, or print the paper version: one sheet, two pens.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. The banner says whose turn it is, with that person's color by name.
Draw one line or shape with a finger, a mouse or a pen. Or use the arrow keys and Space to draw without a pointer.
When you are ready, tap "Pass the pen". Either of you may pass at any time.
Tap "Take back my last line" to remove the newest line of the person whose turn it is.
Tap "Save picture" to make a picture file on this device, or "Print the paper version" for one sheet and two pens.
tips: Sit side by side and talk as you draw: "I will add a sun in the corner."
Start with a dot, a line or a simple shape, and let the other person answer it.
Nobody has to draw a picture of anything. A pattern of lines is just as good as a scene.
If you want to stop, tap "Done for now". Your picture is not kept after you leave the page unless you save it.

faq.q: Is there a winner or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, no score, no timer and no count of turns. There is no right picture, and nothing is ranked or compared.

faq.q: Is the picture saved or sent?
faq.a: No, nothing is sent anywhere. The picture stays on this page until you close it. If you tap Save picture, a file is made on your device for you to download. Nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Can I take back a line?
faq.a: Yes. "Take back my last line" removes the newest line of the person whose turn it is. "Start again" clears the sheet, and "Put it back" brings the lines back, one step only.

faq.q: Can I use this without a mouse or touch screen?
faq.a: Yes. When the drawing has focus, the arrow keys move a pen dot, and the Space key puts the pen down or up. The screen says "Pen down" or "Pen up" each time.

faq.q: What colors are they, and can people with color-blindness tell them apart?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green and purple, the same four colors used in our other picture games. Each has a written name, and the names show beside the turn. The colors were checked with simulations of common color-vision differences, but a person with color-vision differences has not yet tried them.
Yes. "Print the paper version" prints one sheet with the rules on it and a large blank frame to draw in, for two people with two pens. It works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Ewe, kwaneleyo, akukho akhawunti, ukubhalisa okanye ukulanda. Isebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha.

build-together.name: Yakha ndawonye
build-together.seoTitle: Yakha Ndawonye: Abantu Ababini Bakha Iphethini Enye
build-together.h1: Yakha Ndawonye: Abantu Ababini, Igridi Enye
build-together.description: Abantu ababini bathatha iinkqubo zokubeka isiqwenga kwigridi eyabelwanwayo de izaliswe, nganye ngombala wayo onegama nesimo sayo. Akukho mntu owinayo, akukho sithuthi okanye amanqaku. Mahala ukudlala nokuprinta.
build-together.short: Thatha iinkqubo nomntu osecaleni kwakho ukuzalisa igridi enye eyabelwanwayo.
build-together.intro: Igridi eyabelwanwayo enendawo ezi-4 ngezi-4, okanye ezi-3 ngezi-3 ukuba uyathanda. Nganye kwenu ukhetha umbala, kwaye umbala ngamnye unegama elibhaliweyo nesimo sawo. Nithatha iinkqubo: ngexesha lakho, cofa indawo engenanto ukubeka isiqwenga sakho apho. Xa zonke iindawo zinesiqwenga, umfanekiso wakhiwe ndawonye. Akukho mmeli-nqanaba, kuba niyenza njengesibini, kwaye akukho nto egciniweyo okanye ethunyelwayo. "Printa igridi" ibeka igridi engenanto kwiphepha elinye ukuze nakhe ngamapeni amabini.
howTo: Nganye kwenu ukhetha umbala. Umbala onawo omnye umntu uphawulwe ngokuthi "Usetyenziswa".
Umntu wokuqala uqala. Isikrini sibonisa ukuba yiyiphi inkqubo kunye nombala wayo.
Cofa indawo engenanto ukubeka isiqwenga sakho apho. Inkqubo idlulela komnye umntu.
Ukuba akuthandi ukubeka isiqwenga, cofa "Dlula". Nabani na kwenu unokudlula nangaliphi na ixesha.
Xa zonke iindawo zinesiqwenga, nifake umfanekiso ndawonye. Cofa "Qala kwakhona" ukwakha enye, okanye cofa Phumla ukuyeka.
tips: Hlala becala ukuze nobabini nikwazi ukubona nokufikelela kwisikrini. Thetha xa usenza: "Ndiza kubeka eyam ecaleni kweyakho."
Zama ukwakha iphethini, imitya, ibhodi yeqhekeza okanye umda, okanye ubeke iziqwenga naphi na ofuna. Zombini zilungile.
Umntu omncinci okanye umntu okhathala msinya unokudlula amaxesha amaninzi njengoko efuna. Umfanekiso usakhiwa ndawonye.
Kwiphepha, nganye kwenu usebenzisa ipensile enye aze adwelise isimo sakhe kwiikwere ezingenanto.

faq.q: Kukho umntu owinayo, ixesha okanye amanqaku?
faq.a: Hayi. Akukho mntu owinayo, kuba nakha umfanekiso omnye ndawonye. Akukho ywa, manqaku, inani leziqwenga okanye ukulahleka. Ungayeka nangaliphi na ixesha, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi kukho indlela elungileyo yokugqiba.
Hayi. Igridi ihlala kule phepha kuphela. Ayigcinwa, ayifakwa kwi-intanethi, ayibalwa, kwaye iyanyamalala xa uvala iphepha. Ukuba ufuna ukuyigcina, printa igridi wakhe ephepheni.

faq.q: Kuthini ukuba ndibeka isiqwenga kwindawo engalunganga?
faq.a: Akukho ndawo engalunganga. Cofa "Buyisela isiqwenga sokugqibela" kwaye inkqubo ibuyela kuwe. Ungabuyisela inyathelo ngalinye, kwaye nokudlula kunokubuyiswa.

faq.q: Ingaba abantu abanobuthathaka bokubona imibala banokwahlula imibala emine?
faq.a: Yakhethwa ukuze kube njalo. Umbala ngamnye unegama elibhaliweyo kunye nesimo sawo esincinci kwisiqwenga ngasinye, ngoko umbala awusoloko ube yindlela yokwahlula kuphela. Imibala emine ihlolwe ngokusebenzisa iimodeli zobuthathaka bokubona ubomvu-luhlaza nobhlowu-mthubi. Umntu onobuthathaka bokubona imibala akakayizami, ngoko nceda usixelele ukuba ezimbini zifana.

faq.q: Ingaba iindawo zikhulu ngokwaneleyo kwintshukumo okanye isikrini esincinci?
faq.a: Yonke indawo ibanzi okungenani ii-pixel ezi-56. Ukuba igridi likhulu kakhulu kwisikrini, lihamba ngecala ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yalo endaweni yokuncitshiswa kweendawo.
Ewe. "Printa igridi" iprinta igridi engenanto kwiphepha elinye kunye nemibala emibini namagama awo, ukuze nakhe ngamapeni amabini. Isebenza ngomnyama nomhlophe kuba nombala ngamnye unesimo sawo.
Ewe, mahala, kwaye akukho akhawunti, ukubhalisa okanye ukulanda. Isebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha.

seated-toss.name: Ukubala iintrowo ezihlala phantsi
seated-toss.seoTitle: Ukubala Iintrowo Ezihlala Phantsi: Umdlalo Wengxowa Yembotyi Ngabantu Ababini
seated-toss.h1: Ukubala Iintrowo Ezihlala Phantsi: Phosa Ndawonye Etafileni
seated-toss.description: Abantu ababini abahleli etafileni bathatha iinkqubo bephosa ingxowa ethambileyo yembotyi kwinjongo enkulu, babalele iziphumo kwiphepha. Akukho xesha okanye manqaku. Mahala ukuprinta.
seated-toss.short: Thatha iinkqubo uphose ingxowa yembotyi kwinjongo enkulu, nobalo lukwiphepha.
seated-toss.intro: Umdlalo ocothayo wokuphosa wabantu ababini abahleli etafileni. Ubeka injongo eprintiweyo etafileni uze uthathe iinkqubo uphose ingxowa ethambileyo yembotyi, okanye isokisi egoqiweyo, ukuze iwele kwiindandatho. Nganye kwenu igcina ukubala ngokumaka iibhokisi kwiphepha, kwaye nijonge imaki ndawonye xa nime. Akukho xesha, akukho nto ebalwa kwisikrini, kwaye akukho nto egciniweyo okanye ethunyelwayo. Nceda ukuqala ufunde izaziso zokhuseleko: izinto ezincinci ezingaphakathi zingaba yingozi yokubhenela.
howTo: Funda izaziso zokhuseleko. Khetha ingxowa enesiciko esithungiweyo, okanye goqa isokisi ehlanzekileyo.
Cofa "Printa injongo nephepha lokubala" uze ubeke ishiti licwebe etafileni phakathi kwenu.
Hlala ngokuzolileyo, omnye ecaleni kwecala ngalinye, uthathe iinkqubo ngentrowo enye ethambileyo ngamnye. Nabani na unokudlula.
Xa introwo iwela kwindandatho, maka ibhokisi kwikholomu yakho, kwilaynti yale ndandatho.
Jonga imaki ndawonye xa nime, okanye cofa Phumla ukuyima kancinci.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "That was a soft one." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Iphakheji yezixhobo zonyaka
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Iphakheji Yezixhobo Zonyaka: Imidlalo Yephepha Eprintwayo
seasonal-pack.h1: Iphakheji Yezixhobo Zonyaka: Imidlalo Emithathu Yephepha Ngenyanga Nganye
seasonal-pack.description: Imidlalo emincinci emithathu eprintwayo nangayiphi na inyanga yonyaka: dibanisa iimpawu ezifanayo, ujikeleze eyahlukileyo, kwaye ukhuphe umbala kumfanekiso. Iphepha livula kule nyanga, okanye unokhetha enye, okanye usebenzise imini yokuphumla. Akukho mbiza yokuprinta.
seasonal-pack.short: Imidlalo emithathu eprintwayo yenyanga oyikhethileyo, okanye imini yokuphumla.
seasonal-pack.players: Bonke abantu, wedwa okanye ecaleni komnye
seasonal-pack.intro: Khetha inyanga, kwaye iphepha libonisa imidlalo emithathu emincinci yephepha ethathwe kwimifanekiso yale nyanga: imigca emibini yokudibanisa ngemigca, umgca wezinto ezine zokujikeleza eyahlukileyo, kunye nomfanekiso wokukhupha umbala. Iphepha livula inyanga yangoku kwisixhobo sakho. Uprinta iphepha elinye, emva koko wenze enye, emibini okanye zonke ezintathu, ngesantya sakho. Khetha "Namhlanje yimini yokuphumla" esikhundleni salo kungekho nto yokwenza.
howTo: Khetha inyanga, okanye khetha "Namhlanje yimini yokuphumla".
Jonga imidlalo emithathu, emva koko cofa "Printa le phakheji yenyanga".
Yenza enye, emibini okanye zonke ezintathu, ngesantya sakho.
Dibanisa imifanekiso efanayo ngomgca, ujikeleze eyahlukileyo, kwaye ukhuphe umbala womfanekiso omkhulu.
Yima nanini na ukuthanda. Imini yokuphumla nayo ilungile.
tips: Qala ngomdlalo ozibonakala ulula namhlanje. Enye iyanele.
Thetha igama lomfanekiso ngamnye ngokuvakalayo, ukuba kuyanceda.
Sebenzisa iikhrayoni okanye iipensile. Nawaphi na amabala alungile.
Gcina iphepha ukuze kube kwexesha elizayo, okanye limuke.

faq.a: Hayi. Akukho wotshi, amanqaku, ukubala kwezinyathelo okanye ukulahleka. Ungayeka nanini na, kwaye ukuyeka phakathi nayo yindlela elungileyo yokugqiba.

faq.q: Ngaba iphepha liyazi ukuba lixesha nini lonyaka?
faq.a: Hayi. Wena ukhetha ixesha lonyaka. Iphepha alijongi umhla okanye indawo yakho.
Hayi. Akukho nto ekhawulezayo, ebalwayo okanye ejongwayo kwiskrini, kwaye akukho mpendulo eboniswayo. Umdlalo ngamnye ngumfanekiso nje wokujonga, wokudibanisa, wokujikeleza okanye wokukhupha umbala.

faq.q: Kuthini ukuba akukho mntu ufuna imidlalo namhlanje?
faq.a: Khetha "Namhlanje yimini yokuphumla". Iphepha liya kubonisa umgca mnye ozolileyo, kwaye akukho nto yokuprinta okanye yokwenza.
Iphepha elinye lexesha olikhethileyo: imidlalo yalo emithathu, nganye inomgca omfutshane wokuba yenziwa njani, kunye nomgca othi unokwenza enye, emibini okanye zonke ezintathu.
Ewe, ikhululekile, kwaye akukho akhawunti, ukubhalisa okanye ukukhuphela. Isebenza kwi-web browser kwifowuni, kwitabhulethi okanye kwikhompyuter.

decorate-a-card.name: Ukuhombisa ikhadi kunye
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Ukuhombisa Ikhadi Kunye: Ikhadi Lokubulisa Eliprintwayo
decorate-a-card.h1: Ukuhombisa Ikhadi Kunye: Yenzela Umntu Elinye
decorate-a-card.description: Abantu ababini bahombisa ikhadi lokubulisa eliprintwayo ngentsuku yokuzalwa, ngombulelo okanye nje ngenxa yokuthanda, emva koko babhale umyalezo ngasemva kunye. Iikhrayoni okanye iipen kuphela. Akukho wotshi okanye manqaku. Akukho mbiza yokuprinta.
decorate-a-card.intro: Umdlalo wokwenza ozolileyo wabantu ababini abahlala ecaleni komnye. Uprinta ishiti elinye, eligoqwa ngesiqingatha ukwenza ikhadi. Khetha isiganeko, njengentsuku yokuzalwa okanye umbulelo, kwaye uhombise ngaphambili ngokujikeleze amagama alo. Emva koko bhala umyalezo ngasemva, kunye okanye omnye abhale othethwa ngumnye. Sebenzisa iikhrayoni, iipensile zombala okanye ii-felt-tip pens. Akukho khadi elilungileyo ngokungathi, kwaye akukho nto ebalwayo, ithunyelwayo okanye ilinganiswayo ngexesha.
howTo: Chagela isikhethi, uze ucinezele "Print the card".
Goba ishiti ngesiqingatha ngomgca ophukuliweyo, ukuze icala langaphambili lingaphandle.

find-together.seoTitle: Fumana Ndawonye: Abantu Ababini Befumana Iipeyiri
find-together.h1: Fumana Ndawonye: Abantu Ababini, Iqela Elinye
find-together.description: Abantu ababini babelana ngescreen enye baze batshintshane ukuguqula amakhadi amabini emifanekiso ukufuna isipaneli. Iipeyiri zifunyanwa ndawonye zibalwe kwisibalo esinye esabelwanwayo. Mahala ukudlala, akukho wotshi okanye sikolo.

find-together.intro: Amakhadi aqala ngemifanekiso yawo ibonakala, okanye ningawabeka ngasezantsi. Ngexesha lakho uguqula amakhadi amabini. story-dice.short: Phosa amadayisi emifanekiso uze nibalise ibali ndawonye, nangayiphi na indlela.
story-dice.players: abantu aba-2 okanye ngaphezulu, okanye umntu omdala nomntwana
story-dice.intro: Hlanganisa izithombe ezintathu okanye ezine, zifana needayisi. Kunye, yakhani ibali elisebenzisa ezo zithombe, nangayiphi na indlela. Ibali linokuba linye lwesivakalisi okanye ezimbalwa, lunokuba lolonwabo okanye lubonakala njengento eyenzeka ngokwenene. Akukho bali elilungileyo ngokungathi, kwaye akukho mntu ofuneka ukuqamba okanye akhumbule igama. Cofa "Phinda uqengqe" ukufumana izithombe ezintsha, kwaye nabani na angadlula.

quiet-shapes.description: Faka izimo ezilula kumlinganiselo wendlu, isikhephe, intlanzi nezinye. Cofa iqhezu, emva koko indawo enesimo esifanayo. Akukho itayimer okanye amanqaku. Ukudlala nokuprinta simahla.
quiet-shapes.short: Faka izimo ezilula kumfanekiso, ngesantya sakho.
quiet-shapes.intro: Umlinganiselo womfanekiso, njengendlu, isikhephe okanye iroketi, uhlulwe ube ziindawo.
